Aethon transforms routine work so your people can be remarkable. Aethon autonomous mobile robots move medications, specimens, meals, supplies, amenities, linen, waste, and carts throughout complex facilities, so your people can remain focused on patients, guests, and operations. Healthcare and hospitality facilities depend on thousands of recurring trips through corridors, elevators, secured doors, and service areas. When every trip requires an available employee, staffing shortages become workflow delays Talk to an Automation Consultant Solutions for Healthcare Keep clinical and support staff focused on patient care. Automate secure medication and specimen delivery, meal service, linen distribution, waste removal, and cart transport across hospital departments. View our healthcare solutions LABORATORY Deliver blood and surgical specimens to the central lab and blood  products to clinical care teams. Transport specimens and blood products that are unsuitable for pneumatic-tube delivery while reducing reliance on manual transport. ”Explore FOOD SERVICES Deliver food trays from the kitchen anywhere needed in the hospital.  Deliver the used trays back to the kitchen.  Enable room service models efficiently and keep your food service staff near the patient. ”Explore PHARMACY Securely deliver medications and IVs to nursing units and other clinical care areas.  ZenaRx can make multiple secure stops per run. ”Explore ENVIRONMENTAL Heavy bins of trash or biohazard waste can be moved safely and easily.  The robot is compatible with carts that are used by tipper systems. ”Explore SURGICAL & SUPPLIES Deliver or return surgical supplies, tools, equipment or inventory items anywhere needed.  Large and heavy carts are hauled with ease and can be picked up and dropped off automatically. ”Explore LINENS Provide scheduled and on-demand delivery of linens to nursing units.  Bring carts full of clean linen and return carts full of soiled linen in a single run. ”Explore Solutions for Hospitality Deliver guest service without adding another trip to your staff’s workload. Automate room deliveries, amenities, food, packages, and routine material movement across hospitality properties.
